verdict.rationale: Jira's feature page explicitly lists SAML & SSO as a capability, indicating support for enterprise identity federation, but there's no detail on implementation depth (e.g., SCIM provisioning, IdP compatibility, admin controls) and no independent/community corroboration of SSO/SAML working well in practice. missing for 10: technical documentation on SAML/SSO setup, independent verification of reliability, and enterprise-tier scoping details.
